name: Compact Voxel Section Storage
aliases: Sparse Voxel Section Storage with Palette Indexing
definition: A data structure representing a 16x16x16 voxel section that uses three storage modes to minimize memory: Empty (no allocation for all-air), Uniform (no allocation for single material), and Palette (packed indices for mixed materials).
summary: Compact Voxel Section Storage is a memory-optimized representation for 16x16x16 voxel sections that minimizes heap allocation by using bit-packed palette indices for sparse data while supporting O(1) random access.
